metadata.title: Literature Mechanism-Based Inactivator (MBI) Reference Set
metadata.description: Curated collection of 10 documented literature mechanism-based CYP inactivators with characterized bioactivation warheads and peer-reviewed citations.

entries.name: Mibefradil
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Metabolic intermediate complex (MIC) formation with heme iron; potent irreversible inactivation of CYP3A4 leading to fatal drug-drug interactions with statins.
entries.literature_citation: Po et al. (1999) 'What can we learn from mibefradil?', Lancet 353(9157): 989-990; Schmassmann et al. (1998) Mol. Pharmacol. 54(5): 918-927.
entries.notes: Withdrawn from worldwide market in 1998; classic historical archetype of lethal clinical TDI.
entries.ncbi_title: What lessons can be learnt from withdrawal of mibefradil from the market?

entries.name: Diltiazem
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Quasi-irreversible inhibition via nitrosoalkane intermediate forming a stable pseudo-irreversible metabolic intermediate complex (MIC) with ferrous heme iron.
entries.literature_citation: Jones et al. (1999) 'Diltiazem and its metabolites as time-dependent inhibitors of CYP3A4', Br. J. Clin. Pharmacol. 48(4): 543-552.
entries.notes: Prototypical calcium channel blocker causing significant clinical CYP3A4 AUC shifts for co-administered substrates.
entries.ncbi_title: Diltiazem inhibition of cytochrome P-450 3A activity is due to metabolite intermediate complex formation

entries.name: Paroxetine
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Bioactivation of the methylenedioxyphenyl (MDP) ring by CYP2D6 to a reactive carbene intermediate that coordinates tightly to the prosthetic heme iron.
entries.literature_citation: Bertelsen et al. (2003) 'Apparent mechanism-based inhibition of human CYP2D6 in vitro by paroxetine', Drug Metab. Dispos. 31(3): 289-293.
entries.notes: Classic potent mechanism-based inactivator of CYP2D6; converts extensive metabolizers to phenotypic poor metabolizers in vivo.
entries.ncbi_title: Apparent mechanism-based inhibition of human CYP2D6 in vitro by paroxetine: comparison with fluoxetine and quinidine

entries.name: Bergamottin
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Terminal furan ring is oxidized by CYP3A4 to an epoxide/cis-enedione intermediate that covalently modifies the CYP3A4 apoprotein.
entries.literature_citation: He et al. (1998) 'Inactivation of cytochrome P450 3A4 by bergamottin, a component of grapefruit juice', Chem. Res. Toxicol. 11(4): 252-259.
entries.notes: Primary natural constituent responsible for the clinical grapefruit juice effect on intestinal CYP3A4.
entries.ncbi_title: Inactivation of cytochrome P450 3A4 by bergamottin, a component of grapefruit juice

entries.name: Methoxsalen
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Furan ring oxidation generates a reactive dialdehyde/epoxide intermediate that covalently adducts apoprotein residues and destroys active site heme.
entries.literature_citation: Koenigs et al. (1997) 'Mechanism-based inactivation of human liver cytochrome P450 2A6 by 8-methoxypsoralen', Drug Metab. Dispos. 25(12): 1407-1415.
entries.notes: Used in photochemotherapy (PUVA) for psoriasis; potent nanomolar mechanism-based inactivator of CYP2A6.
entries.ncbi_title: Mechanism-based inactivation of human liver cytochrome P450 2A6 by 8-methoxypsoralen

entries.name: Tienilic acid
entries.inactivation_mechanism: S-oxidation of the thiophene ring to a thiophene sulfoxide Michael acceptor, covalently adducting CYP2C9 apoprotein residues and inducing severe autoimmune hepatitis.
entries.literature_citation: Lopez-Garcia et al. (1994) 'Thiophene oxidation by cytochrome P450: reactive intermediates and covalent binding', J. Biol. Chem. 269(46): 28724-28731.
entries.notes: Withdrawn diuretic; archetype of mechanism-based adduction triggering fatal immune-mediated hepatotoxicity.
entries.ncbi_title: Thiophene derivatives as new mechanism-based inhibitors of cytochromes P-450: inactivation of yeast-expressed human liver cytochrome P-450 2C9 by tienilic acid

entries.name: Lapatinib
entries.inactivation_mechanism: CYP3A4-catalyzed O-dealkylation of the fluorobenzyl group generates reactive quinone-imine electrophile; concurrent oxidation of secondary amine yields quasi-irreversible MI complex.
entries.literature_citation: Takakusa et al. (2011) 'Covalent binding and mechanism-based inactivation of cytochrome P450 3A4 by lapatinib', Drug Metab. Dispos. 39(6): 1022-1030.
entries.notes: EGFR/HER2 kinase inhibitor; exemplifies dual metabolic bioactivation pathways in oncology.
entries.ncbi_title: Metabolic intermediate complex formation of human cytochrome P450 3A4 by lapatinib

entries.name: Clopidogrel
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Thienopyridine prodrug bioactivated via 2-oxo-clopidogrel intermediate that covalently binds and irreversibly inactivates CYP2C19 and CYP2B6 enzymes in liver microsomes.
entries.literature_citation: Richter et al. (2004) 'Mechanism-based inactivation of human cytochrome P450 2B6 by clopidogrel', J. Pharmacol. Exp. Ther. 308(3): 979-989.
entries.notes: Present in OpenADMET as OCNT-0498178; negative in standard 30-min CYP3A4 assay, demonstrating target isoform specificity.
entries.ncbi_title: Potent mechanism-based inhibition of human CYP2B6 by clopidogrel and ticlopidine

entries.name: Raloxifene
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Oxidation of the benzothiophene core to a reactive diquinone methide electrophile that covalently binds microsomal proteins and is trapped by glutathione conjugates.
entries.literature_citation: Yu et al. (2004) 'Oxidation of raloxifene by cytochrome P450: evidence for reactive diquinone methide intermediates', Chem. Res. Toxicol. 17(7): 879-888.
entries.notes: Present in OpenADMET as OCNT-0022006; tested against CYP2D6 where it was negative, illustrating target selectivity.
entries.ncbi_title: Oxidation of raloxifene to quinoids: potential toxic pathways via a diquinone methide and o-quinones

entries.name: Furafylline
entries.inactivation_mechanism: Gold-standard selective mechanism-based inactivator of CYP1A2. Undergoes bioactivation of the furfuryl side chain, covalently modifying the active site apoprotein with >100-fold selectivity over CYP3A4/2D6.
entries.literature_citation: Clarke et al. (1994) 'Furafylline is a potent and selective inhibitor of cytochrome P450 1A2 in man', Br. J. Clin. Pharmacol. 37(1): 81-84; Kunze et al. (1993) Chem. Res. Toxicol. 6(5): 649-656.
entries.notes: Classic reference compound included specifically as a positive control for CYP1A2 MBI selectivity against CYP3A4/2D6.
entries.ncbi_title: Characterization of the inhibition of P4501A2 by furafylline
